== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The early target is a ‘non-Jedi Imperial.’ The later target is an Imperial ‘except a Dark Jedi.’ The period Rules distinguish a Dark Jedi from the Light Side Jedi subtype, so the early wording can target a Dark Jedi who is Imperial, such as the original Darth Vader. The Demotion take, another Imperial requirement, remainder of turn and Imperial Command exception carry through.
